explanation: The theorem says that Pic0 of the Igusa function field is generated by classes [P] - [P'], where the points avoid the crossings of C₁ and C₂ and lie in the image of the ιFin chart. Every object it uses is defined in this library: AlgebraicCurve.Pic0, Divisor.degZero, CurveModel.pointEquivPlace, ModularCurve.x1FunctionField, igusaFunctionFieldX1C and TwoChart.modelTo/ιFin. A grep of the Mathlib sources for Pic0, x1FunctionField and igusa returns no files. The proof combines library lemmas (Pic0.mem_closure_mk_single_sub_single_of_notMem, finite_compl_of_isOpen, GenChartTools.good_point, GenChartTools.pic0Mk_congr) with routine Mathlib glue (AddSubgroup.closure_mono, Set.Finite facts). No single Mathlib declaration carries its content.
